articles.title: FTC sues Hims & Hers for allegedly sharing patients’ medical data with advertisers Meta and Snap
articles.description: The U.S. federal consumer watchdog said Hims & Hers, which prescribes for sexual wellness and mental health conditions, used website trackers to share customers' information with advertisers.
articles.summary: The FTC has filed a lawsuit against Hims & Hers over allegations that the company shared patient data with Meta and Snap without consent.
points: Hims & Hers operates in sexual wellness and mental health sectors, prescribing medication for patients
The federal consumer watchdog has accused the firm of using website trackers to share customer information unlawfully with Meta (Facebook) and Snapchat.
The FTC alleges that Hims & Hers shared identifiable data from millions of users without explicit consent, which is a violation of privacy laws.
articles.insight: This news highlights potential issues regarding user privacy in the digital health space and raises concerns about how patient information might be utilized by third parties beyond direct care provision. It underscries the need for transparency when handling sensitive medical data, especially as it pertains to sexual wellness and mental health.

articles.title: Inforcer raises $50M to help prepare smaller businesses for a new world of AI and security risks
articles.description: London-based Inforcer just closed a $50 million Series C round led by Insight Partners.
articles.summary: Inforcer has secured a significant funding of $50 million in its latest investment phase to aid smaller businesses navigate the complexities of AI and heightened security risks.
points: Inforcer, an IT company focusing on cloud-native cybersecurity solutions for SMEs (Small and Medium Enterprises), has raised $50 million in Series C funding led by Insight Partners.

The investment will bolster Inforcer' endorsed products which are engineered to fortify small businesses against emerging cybersecurity threats, particularly from AI-driven adversaries as per the company founder Rohit Bansal. The funds aim at expanding product capabilities and addressing future challenges.
Inforcer aims not only in protection but also education of smaller entities about evolving IT risks related to Artificial Intelligence.
articles.insight: This investment underscores the growing necessity for cybersecurity solutions that cater specifically to SMEs, which are often less equipped than larger corporations. Inforcer's focus on AI-driven threats reveals an industry trend of increasing sophistication among threat actors and a parallel need in defense technologies.

points: - 플러그인 생태계가 보안에 미치는 일쿠손의 영향

articles.title: [속담으로 배우는 100가지 보안 습관 77] 등잔 밑이 어둡다(7)-공용 USB 충전이 위험한 이유
articles.description: 호텔 로비나 비행기 내 공용 USB 충전 포트 사용을 주의하세요보안 사고의 90%는 해킹이 아니라 ‘실수’에서 시작된다. 그래서 우리는 기술보다 습관을 배워야 한다. 속담으로 배우는 100가지 보안 습관에서는 △스마트폰 보안 △계정·비밀번호 △PC·인터넷 △생활 보안 △금융·개인정보 등 100가지 보안 습관을 속담과 연관시켜 소개한다. 보안은 어렵지 않다.
articles.summary: 공용 USB 충전에서의 위험성을 소개하며 실수와 관련된 보안 기술 지식이 중요하다.
points: - 90% 가한 '실수'로 90% 의 보안 사고가 시작되는 것을 강elye 할 수 0ne
- 특정 위험 요인들에 대해서만 최소한으로 대응하여 보안 공동작으로 이주의 기술을 배워야 한다는 것
- 스마트폰, PC, 인터넷, 개인정보 등 공용 장소에서 보안 기술을 외우지 못하지 않도록 최소한의 속담을 통해 보강하여 보격
articles.insight: 공용 USB 받은 위험성은 스마트폰, PC 등의 장소에서와 다른 요인들로 이어지고 있지만, IT/기술업계에서는 최소한의 보안 속담을 따라 공동체제를 구성하여 보호하여야 하다.

articles.title: Microsoft is openly competing with OpenAI, Anthropic more than ever
articles.description: Microsoft pitched its own homegrown AI models, harnesses, and even a Mythos competitor on Wednesday, telling Wall Street it plans for continued growth.
articles.summary: Microsoft announced an expansion in its artificial intelligence division during their latest earnings call with investors and analysts.
points: Microsoft is expanding the AI tools it offers to tackle a broader range of use cases, including search.
articles.insight: The news indicates Microsoft's aggressive competition in the rapidly growing field of artificial intelligence against other prominent players like OpenAI and Anthropic. This could potentially reshape how companies approach AI development moving forward.

articles.title: Mark Zuckerberg predicts that billions of people will have personal AI agents in five years
articles.description: As Meta pours billions into AI infrastructure and agents, Zuckerberg is working to convince investors that the payoff will be worth the price.
articles.summary: In a bold prediction ahead of Meta's AI-centric future unveiled at its annual developer conference, Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg foresees billions using personal AI agents within five years.
points: Mark Zuckerberg predicts the widespinning adoption of personalized artificial intelligence over the next half-decade.
Meta's massive investment into building an infrastructure to support this transformation underscores its commitment, despite potential privacy concerns among users and regulators alike.
The initiative promises AI assistants that understand natural language and personal preferences for each user.
articles.insight: Zuckerberg's vision suggests a paradigm shift in how individuals interact with technology, raising questions about data privacy and the future of human-computer interaction within the IT/technology industry. points: Fast Metals plans to utilize caustic aluminum scraps, which are traditionally considered 'waste', by incorporating them into a proprietary process that extracts critical minerals such as cobalt and lithium for reuse in high-value applications.

Fast Metals aims to provide an alternative through their electrochemical process.

articles.description: 새 체크카드 수령 후 필수 보안 점검금융사기 예방 위한 기본 설정 체크리스트[보안뉴스 강초희 기자] 새 체크카드를 받으면 대부분 비밀번호 등록만 마친 뒤 바로 사용한다. 하지만 카드도 스마트폰처럼 ‘초기 설정’이 필요하다. 해외결제와 결제 알림, 사용 한도 등 기본 보안 설정을 확인하지 않으면 카드 정보 유출이나 부정 사용 발생 시 피해가 커질 수 있다.
articles.summary: 기사는 비밀번호 등을 확보하지 않거나 설정이 되어있지 않은 새 체크카드를 사용한다는 주장에 대해 언급한다.
points: 새 체크카드를 받으면 잘 설정하지 않을 수 0 최소.
기본 보안 설정이 필요하며, 그 외사용 위대한 접근은 방해가 되어 있다.
비밀번호 등을 보장하지 않아도 정신없는 별로만 사용할 수 없다.
articles.insight: 기사는 새 체크카드 감마를 잘하지 못한다는 주장에 대해 강조하고 있으며, 비밀번호 등을 확보하지 않아도 직접 사용이 어렵다는 것을 강조한다.
